title: Wardmoor's 'the true founding record' says plainly 'read it aloud at the oath-stone out on the moor,' but after checking six distinct moor tiles (Moor Road, Cairn Field, Twin Ruts, Peat Score, The Long Sight, Windbreak Stones) I still hadn't located the oath-stone when my turn budget ran out — I was actively searching, not blocked by a puzzle, just out of turns for how spread out this hold is.
